research_question: Does the causal mass asymmetry of unresolved external-liquidity pools determine whether a just-consumed pool rejects toward opposite liquidity or cascades toward the next same-side pool strongly enough to grow a Bybit account after costs?
smc_ict_explanation: Equal highs, equal lows and confirmed swing levels are treated as visible buy-side and sell-side liquidity pools. When a pool is swept, rejection means delivery toward the denser opposite pool; acceptance beyond the pool means stop-loss positive feedback may continue toward the next denser pool in the same direction.

distinct_scope.primitive: persistent unresolved-liquidity pool topology with touch, age, higher-timeframe and local-volume mass
modes: sweep-and-reject reversal toward the nearest sufficiently denser opposite pool
accepted-sweep cascade toward the nearest sufficiently denser same-side pool

data_contract.development_period: 2023-01-01 through 2023-12-31, downloaded only after frozen fit survivors
data_contract.gap_contract: Complete UTC 5-minute grid; every pool and feature state resets at a missing or invalid bar. A position encountering a gap receives the structural stop outcome.

pool_contract.5m_pivot_confirmation: two or three completed bars to the right, selected by the policy
pool_contract.60m_pivot_confirmation: two completed 60-minute bars to the right; mapped only after the confirmation close
pool_contract.touch_weight: one for a 5-minute pivot and two for a confirmed 60-minute pivot
pool_contract.mass: touch weight^1.25 × higher-timeframe participation × capped age visibility × normalized local pivot volume
pool_contract.consumption: high trades at least 0.05 ATR above a buy-side pool or low trades at least 0.05 ATR below a sell-side pool
pool_contract.same_bar_both_sides: no event is created because intrabar order is unknown; both consumed pools retire

event_contract.rejection: buy-side sweep closes bearish back below the pool or sell-side sweep closes bullish back above it
event_contract.continuation: pool sweep closes directionally beyond the pool with strong close location and minimum ATR body
event_contract.target: nearest unresolved pool in the routed direction that meets touch, age, distance and target-mass/swept-mass requirements
event_contract.stop_rejection: beyond the actual sweep extreme plus 0.05 ATR
event_contract.stop_continuation: behind the accepted pool and event extreme
event_contract.position_exit: structural stop, frozen liquidity-pool target or source-gap structural-stop outcome only; no elapsed-time exit
event_contract.period_boundary: open positions are marked and cannot pass the gate; they are never force-closed

development_rule: Freeze at most six highest 18bps fit-growth survivors, writing IDs and fit hash before any 2023 download. Apply the identical gate without rule changes.
promotion_boundary: This discovery sequence cannot rank. A development survivor requires a new 2024-2026 sequential claim using exact Bybit BBO/depth and actual funding.
